basis: Metaphyseal osteosclerosis defines disease; developmental delay in 1/1 does not establish usual neurologic involvement; seizures and intellectual disability are occasional (5-29%).

decisions.neurologic: none: isolated developmental delay does not establish >=30%; neurologic expression is variable. [Case series](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34798323/)

basis: Severe peroxisomal disease with defining encephalopathy; hepatic dysfunction in most and vision loss ~59%; renal cysts ~42% and hearing loss ~37% omitted under cap.

decisions.renal: none: renal cysts ~42% qualify but are omitted under the cap in favor of more frequent, functionally severe ocular disease. [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9221082/)
decisions.neurologic: primary: severe Zellweger disease is defined by profound developmental impairment, neuronal migration defects and seizures.
decisions.ocular: involved: vision loss ~59% in severe Zellweger cohorts; prioritized over renal cysts under the cap. [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9221082/)

basis: Persistent cutaneous capillary ectasia defines disease. Caries (7/12) and predisposed cancers are separate diseases; intrinsic enamel/tooth defects are reported in only 2/12.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: caries in 7/12 is a separately diagnosed dental disease; intrinsic tooth defects occur in 2/12 (~17%); oropharyngeal cancer is a predisposition outcome.

basis: Diabetic metabolic retinal disease is defined by direct retinal capillary injury, microaneurysms, leakage and abnormal vascular growth.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: retinal microangiopathy directly damages capillaries, explicitly included in the cardiovascular axis; generalized vascular disease is not required.

basis: Myopathy 5/5 may represent an overlap subset; >=30% across FPLD2 is unproven. Muscle hypertrophy alone is not injury. [PNDS](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13023-022-02308-7)

decisions.hepatic: none: steatosis (87/108, ~81%) is a separately diagnosed metabolic liver complication; fat deposition alone does not establish function-impairing liver damage.

basis: Cerebroretinal microangiopathy defines disease (brain/retinal lesions 2/2); gastrointestinal hemorrhage 1/2 (50%). Recurrent fractures 1/2 (50%) omitted under cap.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: cerebral and retinal microangiopathy directly affect small blood vessels and define the disorder.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: recurrent fractures in 1/2 (50%) support involvement, but omitted under the four-axis cap; gastrointestinal vascular bleeding is prioritized for severity.

basis: Chronic granulomatous inflammation directly affects anogenital skin/subcutis; isolated disease does not establish intestinal or urinary injury.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: Crohn-like immune-mediated granulomatous skin inflammation can occur without intestinal disease. [Case report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31451228/)

basis: Mitochondrial MNGIE: pseudo-obstruction 7/7, leukoencephalopathy 6/7; macular degeneration 3/7 (~43%). Neurogenic bladder 4/7 reflects neural dysfunction, not direct urinary injury.

decisions.renal: none: neurogenic bladder 4/7 (~57%) reflects damage to neural control; direct bladder-wall or renal injury is not established.
decisions.ocular: involved: macular degeneration in 3/7 (~43%) is direct retinal damage intrinsic to the mitochondrial disorder.

basis: Skeletal muscular dystrophy; cardiac dysfunction is frequent (30-79%; reduced contractility in 3/4 children). Reduced vital capacity reflects respiratory muscle weakness, not lung injury.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: HPO 30-79%; reduced contractility in 3/4 children confirms direct cardiac dysfunction. [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4582941/)

basis: Immune-mediated interstitial lung injury defines this manifestation; articular rheumatoid arthritis is the separately diagnosed underlying disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: articular rheumatoid arthritis is separately diagnosed; this organ-specific pulmonary manifestation does not itself establish direct joint damage.
